metadata.description: Geetashree Oraon is a prominent Congress leader in Jharkhand. Main Bhi Bharat team met her recently and discussed crucial issues regarding Adivasi identity and rights in Jharkhand. She emphasised the need for a separate religion code for tribals and addressed concerns about the delisting of converted Adivasis. In this interview, she also talked about the politics of Adivasi symbols by the BJP.
